body.name: Worked two-variant compatible-law lift
body.construction: Set \(K=2\), \(\omega=\omega_\star^{(2)}\), \(b=b^{(2)}\), \(q=q^{(2)}\), and \(x=x_\star^{(2)}\). Draw \(S\) from \(x_\star^{(2)}\), draw \(A\) independently with probabilities \(\pi\), set \(H^0=H^1\) to the history carried by \(S\), define \(J_t^a\) by \(\mathbf 1\{J_t^a=v\}=\widetilde g_{tav}(S)\) with \(J_t^a=0\) when every such indicator is zero, and reveal \(J=J^A\). Because \(R^{[u]}_{2av}=R^{[0]}_{2av}\) for every \(u\), the lift satisfies the sensitivity restriction for every \(\delta\in[0,1]\).
